summary: A dark node-graph canvas (#131516 with a faint dot grid about 37 px apart) shown wide: a Prompt node top-left (89,119, 310x236) with an inset text box, a "Random noise" node cut off by the left edge (0,318, 249x140), a Sampler node below (161,451, 309x139), and a Processing node on the right (609,105, 322x300) with three input ports (conditioning, noise, sampler) on its left edge and a grey "Awaiting inputs" status line. Cards are #1d1e20-ish, radius about 16 px, with a 1 px lighter border and a soft drop shadow. Type is a light-grey sans: titles white about 15 px semibold, labels grey about 13 px. Output ports are white dots 12 px across on each card's right edge. The clip is a cursor wiring sequence with camera cuts. At 0.4s it cuts to a 1.7x close-up of the Processing input column. A white cable is dragged from Prompt's conditioning port, and a yellow zig-zag lightning spark jumps from the cable tip to the target port, which shows a yellow ring. On release (~1.0s) the cable and both port dots turn yellow, the target gets a double ring, and a yellow glow sweeps along Processing's left edge. At ~1.55s it cuts back to wide, and a yellow check appears at the right of the conditioning row. The noise cable repeats this in pink (~2.65–2.95s, pink check), then the sampler cable in purple (~4.1–4.25s), after which the status reads "All inputs ready". At ~5.0s it cuts to the close-up again, and cables are re-dragged and re-snap in new colours: conditioning turns orange (~5.75–6.15, orange glow, "All inputs ready"), noise turns cyan (~6.45–7.75), then noise turns yellow (~7.95–8.75). While a cable is being dragged it is white and the status falls back to "Awaiting inputs". Each colour comes with a glow sweep around the Processing card edge.

criteria.check: Background is a flat near-black charcoal (~#131516), not pure black and not blue-tinted
A very faint dot grid (dots about 37 px apart, barely brighter than the background) covers the canvas; no solid grid lines
Prompt card spans roughly x 89–399, y 119–355 in the wide view
Cards are a slightly lighter dark grey than the canvas, with corner radius ~16 px, a 1 px faint lighter border and a soft dark shadow
Header reads 'Prompt' in white semibold ~15 px, with a small grey prompt icon to its left
An inset box darker than the card (radius ~8, thin border) sits at about x 112–375, y 181–273
Inset text reads exactly 'A quiet world,' / 'in vivid color. Soft light, subtle' / 'textures, a little unexpected magic.' on three lines in light grey
Each card header has a 2x3 grid of six grey dots at its right (Prompt at x≈366, Processing at x≈898)
The Random noise card is cut off by the left frame edge so its title reads 'andom noise', at y≈318–458, overlapping the bottom of the Prompt card
The noise card shows '432512' in grey and an output labelled 'noise' at its right edge
Sampler card spans roughly x 161–470, y 451–590, overlapping the Random noise card's lower right
Sampler card reads 'Sampler' (white, with a sliders icon), 'euler · 24 steps' (grey) and output 'sampler'
Processing card spans roughly x 609–931, y 105–405 in the wide view
Header reads 'Processing' in white semibold, with a CPU-chip outline icon to its left
Three input rows read 'conditioning', 'noise', 'sampler' top to bottom, about 58 px apart, in grey ~13 px
The three input port dots sit on the card's left border at x≈608, y≈200, 258 and 315
Unconnected ports are solid white circles about 12 px across, not hollow rings
Below the inputs a small grey dot and the dim grey text 'Awaiting inputs' appear
A white arrow mouse pointer is visible on the canvas, dragging a cable tip
While being dragged, a cable is white, ~4 px thick, a smooth bezier curve, and its source port gets a thin ring
Between 0.2s and 0.7s the view jumps to a ~1.7x close-up: Processing's left edge moves from x≈609 to x≈653 and its title grows from ~15 px to ~26 px
A thin glowing yellow zig-zag (lightning), not a straight line or dotted line, joins the dragged cable tip to the conditioning port
While hovering, the target conditioning port has a thin yellow ring (~45 px across in close-up) with a soft yellow glow
When the cable connects, it turns from white to yellow (#f2dc4a-ish) along with both of its end dots
A connected cable has a soft outer glow in its own colour, with no dark outline
On connect, the target port shows two concentric thin rings in a muted version of the cable colour
After connecting, a soft blurred yellow glow runs down Processing's left border and wraps the top-left corner; it is a diffuse light, not a hard stroke
By 2.15s the view is back to the wide framing, with all four cards visible as at 0.2s
A thin yellow check mark appears at the right end of the conditioning row (x≈900, y≈200)
While the noise cable is dragged, the zig-zag spark and the target ring are pink/magenta
The noise cable from (248,423) to (608,258) is white at 2.65s and solid pink with pink end dots by 3.6s
The noise row gets a pink check mark at x≈900, y≈258
A white cable is being dragged up from the Sampler port (469,556) toward the canvas, with the cursor at its tip
Near the sampler input the spark and the ring are violet/purple
Each input has its own colour: conditioning yellow, noise pink, sampler purple
Once all three are connected, the status changes to a white dot and 'All inputs ready' in lighter text
Between 4.1s and 4.97s the view cuts again to the ~1.7x close-up, framing the Processing inputs at x≈653
While the conditioning cable is re-dragged, it is white again with a white target port, and the status reads 'Awaiting inputs'
The conditioning cable changes from white (4.97s) to orange/coral (5.95s), with an orange glow sweep on Processing's left edge
The re-dragged noise cable shows a cyan ring and spark at the noise port at 6.55s, and it is solid cyan with a cyan edge glow by about 7.5s
The noise cable is re-dragged again and snaps yellow, so by about 9s the conditioning cable is orange, noise yellow and sampler purple
In the close-up, the purple sampler cable enters from the bottom edge at x≈520 and curves up into the sampler port at (652,463)
Every glow (cable, ring, edge sweep) is a soft additive blur of the cable colour; there is no flat coloured band or hard-edged outline around the card
Titles are near-white, port labels mid grey (~#a0a0a0) and the status text dimmer grey, so there are three distinct brightness levels
